description: BOSZ 2024 release tree at MAST (HLSP), verified live 2026-10-17 (bulk-download surface, directory indexes, official README 2026-10-18). The upstream publishing unit is one (broadening, metallicity) directory; its official bulk package is the per-directory bulkdl.sh script — a plain list of per-file curl commands covering every spectrum file of that directory. The rorig directories additionally hold the line-identification product line, which the official scripts omit; its complete authoritative listing is the directory's own Apache index, mirrored as a designed part (directory_index.html). stellarlib mirrors whole directories: one product = one (broadening, metallicity) directory — spectra as enumerated by the official bulkdl script, lineid files as enumerated by the directory index — plus one shared product for the wavelength_grids directory. The blueprint declares all 112 directory mirrors.
license: CC BY 4.0 (stated on the landing page)
archived_docs: docs/upstream/bosz2024/ (verbatim README + dated landing-page snapshot, byte-identical under git attribute -text)

verified.note_original_sampling: rorig/ holds the original-sampling variant (noresam files, own wavelength column); original resolution varies per model, ~200,000-600,000

bulk_download_surface.verified: 2026-10-18: 112 scripts listed under download_scripts/, one per (broadening, metallicity); no directory-level tarballs exist (probes 404)
bulk_download_surface.files_per_script: spectra per directory differ by metallicity (all 14 rorig scripts downloaded and counted 2026-10-18; numbered directories hold the same node structure — r500 m+0.00 verified 45,724 = its rorig counterpart)
bulk_download_surface.spectra_total: 628,620 per broadening — the official README states the same number; the sum of the 14 counted scripts equals it exactly

lineid_product_line.official_description: README: three columns (wavelength in Angstroms, a string of line identifications, equivalent width W in Angstroms); weak lines with W < 0.1 Angstroms are not listed; only for rorig, one file per v0 spectrum
lineid_product_line.count_per_directory: = the v0 spectrum count = spectra/4 (11,431 at m+0.00, 10,829 at m-2.50; total 157,155 across the 14 metallicities)
lineid_product_line.official_packaging_defective: download_scripts/hlsp_bosz_bosz2024_sim_rorig_all_v1_bulkdl-lineids.sh is named 'all' (landing-page table: 'all_lineids') but lists 10,829 files, m-2.50 only; per-metallicity variants do not exist (probes 404) — it cannot anchor the product line
lineid_product_line.authoritative_listing: the directory's own Apache index (served at the directory URL): rorig/m+0.00 lists exactly 45,724 noresam + 11,431 lineid and nothing else; the lineid set equals the script's v0 names with the product slot swapped (set equality verified on m+0.00 and m-2.50); stellarlib caches it as part directory_index.html and enumerates lineid parts from it

verified.recomputation_2025_09_24: README update notice: all models were recomputed (OH+ partition-function fix; higher-level hydrogen atom, H lines now present to 32 micron). The files served since are the recomputed set; stellarlib's checksums were taken against it.
verified.root_tree_quirk: the release root additionally publishes hlsp_bosz_bosz_sim_all_all_v1_readme.txt~ (editor leftover beside the README); recorded, never mirrored. The landing page's own 'Read Me' link inserts a wrong '2024' into the filename and 404s.

sample_file_sizes_bytes_per_resolution.note: one HEAD sample per resolution at m+0.00 (gz size varies with model); order-of-magnitude scale, not an inventory

filename_variant_axes.note: enumerated from the rorig m+0.00 script's 45,724 names (2026-10-18); matches the README's stated ranges ([a/M] -0.25 to +0.5, [C/M] -0.75 to +0.5, vmicro 0/1/2/4 km/s); 24 compositions x 14 metallicities = the README's '336 unique compositions'

verified.wavelength_grids_note: seven files, one per numbered resolution; rorig needs none (noresam files carry their own wavelength column)

format_notes: resam files are two-column gzip ASCII (Eddington flux H_lambda, continuum) with no wavelength column; rows align by index with the per-resolution wavelength grid file
rorig noresam files carry their own wavelength column (three columns: wavelength, H_lambda, continuum); lineid files are three-column (wavelength, line-ID string, equivalent width)
wavelength grids are log-uniform; r500 spans 500 Angstrom to 31.97 micron in 7500 points, r10000 in 150000 points
upstream clips H_lambda below 1e-6 erg/s/cm^2/Angstrom to zero (continuum to 1); no checksums are published
references: Meszaros, S., et al. 2024, A&A, 688, A197
Bohlin, G., et al. 2017, AJ, 154, 106 (legacy library)
